10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10781|cb1093ae.name: Royal Overseer Bauhaus
10781|cb1093ae.text: I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.

10839|837a33af.name: Argent Officer Garush
10839|837a33af.text:
Well met, friend.  I am Officer Garush, and I am a proud member of a world-wide organization known as the Argent Dawn.  Our cause is to fight swiftly and mercilessly against any element of evil that surfaces in Azeroth.  We are not a political body, nor do we ever wish to become one.  Our cause is singular, and to that end we call both the Horde and Alliance as friends - friends in the cause of stamping out evil!

For the Dawn, my brother!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

11870|a5868f28.name: Archibald
11870|a5868f28.text:
Sayoc is the orc weapon master.  He is located in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.  He can train the use of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons.

Hanashi, the troll weapon master in the Valley of Honor of Orgrimmar, can instruct in the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and all thrown weapons.

Ansekhwa, the tauren weapon master, is on Thunder Bluff's lower rise.  He teaches the use of one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

1743|a67f19d2.name: Deathguard Lawrence
1743|a67f19d2.text: Clyde Kellen, the local bass master, has his favorite fishing spot just east of Brill at Brightwater Lake.

1746|a67f19d2.name: Deathguard Cyrus
1746|a67f19d2.text: Clyde Kellen, the local bass master, has his favorite fishing spot just east of Brill at Brightwater Lake.

1746|d821d003.name: Deathguard Cyrus
1746|d821d003.text: Sorry friend, we don't have one of those here in Brill.  You'll have to head to the Undercity for that.  The Undercity is underneath the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of Brill.  From the back of the ruins take the elevator down and then speak to one of the Undercity Guardians to find your way further.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

246349|da04ef25.name: Breton Samuels
246349|da04ef25.text:
If you've come seeking the fellowship of your fellow paladins, you've come to the right place. 

Welcome home.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "Horde" with the rest of our people.

246393|4b78c376.name: Jorin Croge
246393|4b78c376.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

246393|533ec9c8.name: Jorin Croge
246393|533ec9c8.text:
I make sure we are provisioned and that the scant resources we do have are distributed properly.

If this were a proper order, I'd be something of a quartermaster. Such as we are, however, I just do my best to make sure we are at least somewhat equipped to deal with the dangers all around us.

2485|6e89a35a.name: Larimaine Purdue
2485|6e89a35a.text: As a $c, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4605|1690954e.name: Basil Frye
4605|1690954e.text: I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.

5492|08830bac.name: Katherine the Pure
5492|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5492|837f02f9.name: Katherine the Pure
5492|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5497|8fca8484.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5624|00d342d3.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|00d342d3.text: James Van Brunt in War Quarter on inner ring.

5624|dd3eed63.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|dd3eed63.text: We not so sure paladins safe to touch, but they at War Quarter in big building.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5690|c2467ddc.name: Clyde Kellen
5690|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

117-complete.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-complete.text:
Hops and Barley, yeast and malt 
The taste-buds feel a virtual assault, 
No need to plead, no need to beg 
For Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
117-complete.title: Thunderbrew

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

139-accept.name: Unknown
139-accept.text: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment.  This one reads:  Now from this here barrel, face ye North.  Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs.  If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.
139-accept.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

139-complete.name: Unknown
139-complete.text: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!
139-complete.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

14-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-complete.text: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for Westfall yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.
14-complete.title: The People's Militia

140-accept.name: Unknown
140-accept.text: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sander's treasure.  The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text:  Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure!  Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore.  Once ye get to the water, keep going!  Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
140-accept.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

140-complete.name: Unknown
140-complete.text:
The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work.  You force the chest open and take the booty.

Congratulations!
140-complete.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

1649-accept.name: Unknown
1649-accept.text:
Valor, and all the virtues that go along with it, are like rare minerals: you must cherish them when you find them because of their value, but you must also take time to harvest them... refine them. When mixed together properly, a strong alloy is formed, sometimes unbreakable by even the most powerful blows.

This strength, your faith, your bravery, must be tested. You must learn to never lose faith and realize that with the power of the Light, you can overcome things that most others cannot.
1649-accept.title: The Tome of Valor

1649-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1649-complete.text:
Ah, you wish to petition me for a test of valor. Splendid.

There are many tasks throughout the city and surrounding lands that hold much challenge, and they could use a man with your skills.

This test should not be taken lightly, $N. This, like many things along our path, could take our lives. The Church always wishes to bolster its ranks, but it understands the sacrifices needed to ensure the paladins serving it are worthy.

Are you prepared?
1649-complete.title: The Tome of Valor

1650-accept.name: Duthorian Rall
1650-accept.text:
Good! Your lack of hesitation is a sure sign that you are prepared and eager to test yourself. So be it.

At the very ends of Westfall's Longshore, a small house overlooks the ocean. There, a couple lives, the Stilwells. Jordan is an incredible smith, and he's gone to Ironforge to meet with the dwarves for a while. But this has left Daphne, his wife, alone and unprotected.

Reports suggest that the Defias have all but taken over the area, Daphne may need some protection from the villains. Go there.
1650-accept.title: The Tome of Valor

167-complete.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-complete.text: My suspicions were correct.  My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
167-complete.title: Oh Brother...

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-complete.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-complete.text: Thank you for collecting these, $N.  Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy.  I will see to it that the families are notified.
168-complete.title: Collecting Memories

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

1793-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1793-complete.text:
It has been proven that the Light is with you, $N, but as times grow more dangerous, it becomes important to know what strength lies beneath the flesh. When demons, dragons, or any other evil set foot in your lands, your mettle will be tested. Will you be strong enough?

Bravery, regardless of the situation, is as much a part of paladinhood as the Light, your armor, and your weapon. Protecting the weak, and not losing faith are two more lessons you must master while you study in the Cathedral of Light.
1793-complete.title: The Tome of Valor

1920-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-complete.text:
Very well done!  I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.

Your value to the society of mages grows, $N.
1920-complete.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-progress.text: Have you captured the creatures, $N?  They must be studied in order to determine the reason behind their arrival.
1920-progress.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1921-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1921-accept.text:
You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe.  Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials  

The robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.

Gather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the $C District.
1921-accept.title: Gathering Materials

2040-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-complete.text: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
2040-complete.title: Underground Assault

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

2923-accept.name: Brother Sarno
2923-accept.text:
Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot.  I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.

Very sad.  But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!

Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge.  He would welcome your help.
2923-accept.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

354-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
354-accept.text:
The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!

Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
354-accept.title: Deaths in the Family

356-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-accept.text:
The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
356-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

358-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-accept.text:
The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  

The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!

Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
358-accept.title: Graverobbers

362-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
362-accept.text:
Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different.  Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb.  His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin.  Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
362-accept.title: The Haunted Mills

365-accept.name: Deathguard Simmer
365-accept.text:
What have we here?  You look like a fledgling $c.  If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The Forsaken.

To the west you'll find a farm.  Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse.  And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower.  Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.

Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
365-accept.title: Fields of Grief

365-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-complete.text: You have performed your bidding well, young $c.  You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
365-complete.title: Fields of Grief

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise.  She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.

My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
367-accept.title: A New Plague

367-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-complete.text: You have done well $N, and I thank you for your efforts.
367-complete.title: A New Plague

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

368-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-accept.text:
While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.

I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity.  You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
368-accept.title: A New Plague

368-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-complete.text: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
368-complete.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

369-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-accept.text:
While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.
369-accept.title: A New Plague

369-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-complete.text: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, $N.  Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down.  Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
369-complete.title: A New Plague

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

370-accept.name: Executor Zygand
370-accept.text:
The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands.  According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.

Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
370-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

373-complete.name: Baros Alexston
373-complete.text:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
373-complete.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

374-accept.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-accept.text:
Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.

Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, $c. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
374-accept.title: Proof of Demise

374-complete.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-complete.text: Varimathras would be proud.  You serve your leaders well, $c.
374-complete.title: Proof of Demise

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

375-accept.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-accept.text:
It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The Mindless State will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, $N, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
375-accept.title: The Chill of Death

383-complete.name: Executor Zygand
383-complete.text:
Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, $N. Hmm... names of the officers in the Tirisfal Glades...

Imagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.
383-complete.title: Vital Intelligence

389-accept.name: Baros Alexston
389-accept.text:
VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
389-accept.title: Bazil Thredd

389-complete.name: Warden Thelwater
389-complete.text:
What in the Light do you want? Can't you see we have a crisis here?

Bazil Thredd?! Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
389-complete.title: Bazil Thredd

391-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
391-accept.text:
Let's get one thing straight, $N: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
391-accept.title: The Stockade Riots

398-accept.name: Unknown
398-accept.text:
Wanted: Maggot Eye!

A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken.  This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army.  Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.

The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution.  Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.

Mercy is for the weak.
398-accept.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

398-complete.name: Executor Zygand
398-complete.text: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged.  Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people.  On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.
398-complete.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

399-complete.name: Baros Alexston
399-complete.text: Oh, thank you, $N! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
399-complete.title: Humble Beginnings

404-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-accept.text:
Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.

Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
404-accept.title: A Putrid Task

404-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-complete.text: Well done.  I regret not being there to see you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
404-complete.title: A Putrid Task

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

407-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
407-accept.text:
Harmless pumpkins, right?  Or so it would seem.  If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.

With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady.  This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.

Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.  Take this pumpkin to the fool.
407-accept.title: Fields of Grief

407-complete.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-complete.text: By the Light!  Finally some food!  Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .
407-complete.title: Fields of Grief

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

426-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-accept.text:
The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

The orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

Go to the Mills.  Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

To get to the Mills, follow the road west.  After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north.  When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
426-accept.title: The Mills Overrun

427-accept.name: Executor Zygand
427-accept.text:
The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade.  We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.

But the Deathguard has larger concerns.  The Lich King's army grows in number each night.  We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.

Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.
427-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

427-complete.name: Executor Zygand
427-complete.text: Most excellent, $c.  Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.
427-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

445-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
445-accept.text:
Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.
445-accept.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

492-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
492-accept.text:
According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured.  The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.

Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him?  It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.
492-accept.title: A New Plague

492-complete.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-complete.text: Ah, a drink at last.  I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
492-complete.title: A New Plague

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

5481-accept.name: Gordo
5481-accept.text:
Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.

When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.
5481-accept.title: Gordo's Task

5481-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-complete.text:
What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.

Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
5481-complete.title: Gordo's Task

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

5482-accept.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-accept.text:
So you can see the predicament that I'm in, $N. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.

It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
5482-accept.title: Doom Weed

5482-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-complete.text:
Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
5482-complete.title: Doom Weed

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

8-accept.name: Calvin Montague
8-accept.text:
Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?

I got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.

Anyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
8-accept.title: A Rogue's Deal

8-complete.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-complete.text:
Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.

What? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?

Well, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!

Come back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.

Next thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.
8-complete.title: A Rogue's Deal

8-progress.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-progress.text:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8-progress.title: A Rogue's Deal

91209-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
91209-complete.text:
Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.
91209-complete.title: Continue Your Training

91282-accept.name: Shari Stilwell
91282-accept.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new $c order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282-accept.title: A Second Home

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed
